name: Dr. Gary Chapman

notes: His own site (5lovelanguages.com) has no email, only a contact form at /contact (topics include 'Speaking request') and a media request form at /media. The email is on the contact page of his Moody Radio programme 'A Love Language Minute' (Moody is his publisher/broadcaster): 'Feel free to send your comments or questions to garychapman@moody.edu'. Speaker bureaus (All American Speakers, AAE) list him but are generic bureaus, not used.
doubtful: garychapman@moody.edu is the radio programme's listener inbox at Moody, likely read by programme staff; the 5lovelanguages.com form may be the better route.
